bridges.narrative: AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, and Lawyers for Civil Justice file an open APA-challenge letter to OSTP within 24 hours of the May 7 FMRB EO interagency draft, while Senators Warner and Young request a NIST/ODNI threshold briefing on May 15. The civil-society and Senate pressure layer operationalizes the political-operativeness condition the prediction names.
bridges.remaining_gap: No White House signed EO or Federal Register notice publishes today; the comment-fight coalition forms but the artifact itself is still pending.

bridges.narrative: Singapore IMDA and Japan AISI sign a parallel cyber-eval reciprocity MoC citing the May 7 EU-UK protocol as template, with Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC observing; HM Treasury extends the LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause to 30 days naming Gemini Code Assist and GitHub Copilot for Government. Four-jurisdiction recognition plus named-vendor freeze sharpens the cyber-capability category landing.
bridges.remaining_gap: No US BIS rule, NIST AI Cyber Center follow-up, or executive order publishes today; foreign-side reciprocity hardens but the US executive artifact is still absent.

bridges.narrative: CBRS opens at $151.40 (+18.3% over the $128 IPO price) and closes near $148 with ~$31.4B fully-diluted market cap on first-day volume of ~28M shares, exceeding the $22-25B band by ~25%. The valuation half lands above the named threshold but the +18.3% first-day pop falls short of the >=30% bar — empirical outcome splits the prediction.
bridges.remaining_gap: First-day pop magnitude undershoots the >=30% threshold the prediction names; the valuation result lands but the pop result does not.

bridges.narrative: Cerebras's $31.4B first-day cap plus the $4.9B OpenAI warrant paper gain reset the public-market comparable, and Tenstorrent confirms a $3.4B IPO bridge with Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as co-anchors targeting a July S-1 while shipping the Wormhole Galaxy rack to CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe, and Hyundai Robotics. The continuation-play precondition the prediction names is now operative.
bridges.remaining_gap: No second AI-accelerator issuer prices a >$10B IPO today; the comparable hardens and S-1 timelines tighten but the second pricing event has not yet landed.

bridges.narrative: OpenAI's $1B warrant package marks roughly $4.9B paper gain at first-day close, and SEC Corp Fin's sample comment letter explicitly cites the Cerebras-OpenAI warrant as a related-party-disclosure comparable for selected hyperscaler issuers. Cerebras's CS-4 announcement under a standing $10B OpenAI multi-year supply agreement extends the warrant template into a multi-deal cadence the SambaNova, Groq, and Tenstorrent S-1 cohort will inherit.
bridges.remaining_gap: SambaNova, Groq, and Tenstorrent S-1 filings have not yet posted; the SEC comparable is named but the disclosed exhibit cadence is still pending.

bridges.narrative: SEC Corp Fin posts a sample comment letter to Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta requesting clarification on AI-services-revenue measurement basis, capital-allocation attribution, and customer-concentration footnote schedule for the Q2 10-Q. Alphabet's analyst day moves to May 21 with a confirmed Gemini training-cluster cost-of-revenue topic. Disclosure pressure escalates from buyside framing to formal regulator inquiry inside one news cycle.
bridges.remaining_gap: No Q2 10-Q with a discrete AI-services revenue footnote ships today; the regulator inquiry lands but issuer-side filings remain ahead of the fiscal-cycle cutoff.

bridges.narrative: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed Skill Catalog, Agent Registry preview, and Agent Governance Center inside 24 hours of the May 7 Anthropic + OpenAI launch. Anthropic posts day-one telemetry of 11,400 skills published, 612K installs, and 38 enterprise opt-ins under the Mythos Preview rider — the >=1 hyperscaler-managed-tier landing condition is overshot.
bridges.remaining_gap: Enterprise-RFP language naming signed-skill registry as procurement default has not yet published; the supply side overshoots but the buyer-side RFP artifact is still pending.

bridges.narrative: AWS Bedrock Agent Registry preview with FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance and Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center with per-tenant Mythos-class gating ship audited signed-skill provenance schemas alongside Microsoft Azure AI Foundry's Skill Catalog. Cisco Astrix's Defender XDR-integrated MCP gateway adds the data-plane control surface — the >=2 Big-3 default-on plus independent attestation shape is operative.
bridges.remaining_gap: AWS Bedrock and Vertex remain in preview rather than GA default-on; the schema lands but the default-policy enforcement step still requires GA promotion.

bridges.narrative: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship parallel managed registry tiers inside 24 hours of the May 7 dual lab launch, and Anthropic's Mythos Preview opt-in by JPMorgan, Booz Allen, Mandiant, and Raytheon under a contractual ethics-and-misuse rider supplies the carveout-language template a hyperscaler JV would extend.
bridges.remaining_gap: No hyperscaler files an 8-K announcing an analogous JV template with audited revenue-share footnote today; the contractual primitive is in place but the JV artifact has not yet shipped.

bridges.narrative: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed signed-skill registries with per-tenant gating in parallel; Cisco Astrix's MCP-server identity gateway integrating Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger lands as the first cross-vendor control-plane stack with visibility on >60% of new MCP-server provisioning events.
bridges.remaining_gap: No NIST SP 800-series draft profile or SP 800-53 NHI overlay publishes today; cross-vendor empirical inputs harden but the standards artifact is still absent.
